changes: Converted publisher RIS fields to BibTeX.
Represented RIS SP as an article identifier (eid), confirmed by Crossref and the PDF first-page citation.
Also included the article identifier in note so IEEEtran BibTeX displays it; eid alone is ignored by that style.
Used the 2026 issue year from Crossref published-print and PDF header, preserving RIS PY=2025 and online date 2025-12-24 in provenance.
authorization: User explicitly requested RIS conversion and Crossref supplementation on 2026-11-03.
